notes.title: 2025-07-20 핫픽스
notes.content:
Patch Notes
July 20, 2025


1. Interaction Bug on In-Game HUD
Fixed a bug where interactions did not work properly when hovering over HUD elements (excluding buttons).


2. Extended Daytime for Tutorial
Extended the daytime duration on Day 1 to provide more time for the tutorial.


3. Unequip Bug
Fixed a bug where equippable items would be unequipped when reacquired after being equipped via pickup or crafting.


4. Inventory Not Opening Bug
Fixed a bug where the inventory window would not open properly after placing an object.


5. Auto Interaction Disable Bug
Fixed a bug where auto interaction would stop working if the target object died during the interaction.


6. Item Crafting Bug
Fixed a bug where crafted items were not correctly added to the inventory.


7. Village Generation Algorithm Bug
Fixed a bug where previously placed village objects were not removed when the algorithm determined a new starting point after failing to place enough buildings.

notes.title: 2025-07-20 Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes
July 20, 2025


1. Main Screen Overhaul
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44565697/99421068b33d6412a2c8a2aa5315697369420bf0.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44565697/15f276b75c8d662b48e6c0ad799d87046bd58632.png"]

The navigation bar has been removed, and the central area now features a magic orb and a magic circle to access Missions and Upgrades, respectively. At the bottom center, the number of remaining chances (lives) is displayed. When hovering over the orb or circle, the name of the active function is shown for better clarity.

Remaining lives are visually represented by the number of spirits orbiting the magic orb.

You can now access Missions via the magic orb and Upgrades via the magic circle, all while viewing your remaining lives in the center of the screen!


2. Mouse Locking Feature Added
The mouse cursor is now confined within the game screen and will no longer move outside the window.


3. Camera Movement Method Changed
Previously, the camera moved by dragging with the right mouse button.

Now, the camera moves automatically when the cursor is placed near the edge of the screen.


4. Auto Interaction Enabled by Default
No more endless clicking! Now, a single mouse click will automatically trigger periodic interactions with the target object.

Use your time for strategic decisions instead of grinding clicks.

As a result, the "Automation" upgrade has been removed from the upgrade tree, and the cost of the attack speed upgrade has been adjusted.


5. Hotkey System Overhauled
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44565697/274c8e0a839394dc643b96bf7d85906d396ceac9.png"]

The previous hotkeys used to toggle the inventory and crafting windows have been replaced.

Now, in the main screen, the ESC key opens and closes the menu, and also closes the mission and upgrade windows.

In-game, ESC still opens and closes the menu, while I opens the inventory and C opens the crafting window.

You can now open a new window without closing the others first.


6. Tutorial Added
\[Main Screen Tutorial][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44565697/536411c2452e5309dff1edd8635d46d73f04c527.png"]

\[In-game Screen Tutorial][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44565697/d965e174893a06bb6f8bd4c471ba4ef6b3f78603.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44565697/4e21fe23615f50a2a2199f9930ec4190bbf9654c.png"]

To help new players, the divine agent now guides them through tutorials on both the main screen and in-game.

The tutorial explains the screen layout and how to play.

Press Spacebar or click the dialogue box to proceed, and press ESC to skip.


7. Bug Fix: Game Freeze on Entering Stage
Fixed a bug where the game would freeze during stage generation if it failed to place a sufficient number of building objects, causing an infinite loop.

notes.title: 2025-07-16 Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes
July 16, 2025


1. Graphics Improvements
The following graphics have been improved:

Terrain: Dirt and water tile images

Some Field Objects: Village buildings, trees, and rocks

Some Item Icons: Stone, iron, and iron axe icons


2. Visibility Improvements
Fixed an issue where the values (such as health) of field objects were not visible when hovered with the mouse if they were obscured.


3. Title Screen Animation Added
The divine agent, who appears when the protagonist first opens their eyes, has been added to the center of the title screen to match the story. Fog has also been added to enhance depth and atmosphere.


4. In-Game Hotkeys Added
Hotkeys have been added to toggle UI windows:
Press I to open/close the inventory, C for the crafting window, and ESC for the menu.


5. Intro Scene Added
To enhance immersion at the start of the game, the divine agent’s voice is now shown as text. Press Spacebar to proceed or ESC to skip.


6. New Monster Added
Slime
Description: A small jelly-like creature that slowly moves and attacks.
Stats:

HP: 3

Attack: 1

Drop Items: Viewable in-game


7. Village Generation Algorithm Updated
The building placement algorithm at the start of a stage has been changed.
Previously, buildings were placed completely at random. Now, buildings are placed around a central point to form a more natural village layout.

notes.title: 2025-07-13 Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes
July 13, 2025


1. UI Interaction Improvements
Fixed an issue where field objects could be unintentionally affected when using the mouse over UI elements.


2. Visibility Improvements
The background color has been changed from black to dark gray to help distinguish the game map from the background more clearly.


3. Settings Menu
Added a settings button to both the main menu and the in-game menu.
You can now adjust sound settings and change the language during gameplay!


4. Construction System Implemented
A system has been added that allows players to place objects on the field.
When selecting a buildable item from the inventory, the game enters construction mode, allowing placement of the object on the field.
A green outline indicates the object can be placed, while a red outline indicates it cannot.
Pressing the ESC key while in construction mode will cancel it and return to interaction mode.



The following construction items have been added: Campfire, Wall, Altar of Fire, Altar of Lightning.
[hr][/hr]
Campfire
Description: Illuminates the area around it for a limited time. Interacting with it consumes 1 wood to extend its duration.
Craftable: Yes
Materials: 20 Wood, 10 Stone
[hr][/hr]
Wall
Description: A durable obstacle. Interacting with it consumes 1 stone to increase its durability.
Craftable: Yes
Materials: 50 Stone
[hr][/hr]
Altar of Fire
Description: An altar that launches flames at nearby enemies. Interacting with it consumes wood to increase its durability.
At certain durability levels, its damage, firing speed, and projectile speed increase.
Craftable: Yes
Materials: Viewable in-game
[hr][/hr]
Altar of Lightning
Description: An altar that attacks nearby enemies with lightning. Interacting with it consumes wood to increase its durability.
At certain durability levels, its damage, firing speed, and casting speed increase.
Craftable: Yes
Materials: Viewable in-game


5. Terrain Generation Improvements
Previously, water tiles were placed randomly to create terrain.
Now, terrain elevation is generated using Perlin noise, and land and sea are determined based on the elevation, resulting in more natural terrain.


6. Field Object Spawn Logic Added
In addition to spawning objects based on day/night cycles and time segments,
a new system has been added to always generate resource objects in the field.
Now the field will always contain a sufficient number of resource objects.


7. UI Hidden After Stage Ends
Fixed an issue where the inventory and item info windows remained open after a stage ended.


8. Sound Settings Saved
Your sound settings are now saved and will be automatically loaded the next time you launch the game.

notes.title: 2025-07-09 Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes
July 9, 2025


1. Bug Fixes
Stage Afterimage
Fixed an issue where death animations of objects remained visible when transitioning from a stage to the main screen.

Health Bug
Fixed a bug where field objects would not die even when their health reached 0.


2. Inventory and Crafting Item Info Display
You can now view item information by hovering over items in the inventory and crafting menus.


3. Sound Settings Added
Sound settings have been added to the title screen. You can now adjust master volume, background music, and sound effects separately.


4. In-Game Camera Movement and Boundary Limitation
You can now move the in-game camera by right-clicking and dragging. Camera movement is restricted to within the boundaries of the map.


5. New Items Added
Iron Axe
Description: An axe made of iron. Used for chopping down trees. Grants +10 attack power when equipped.
Craftable: Yes
Crafting Cost: 10 Wood, 50 Stone, 30 Iron

Torch
Description: A torch that lights up the surrounding area. Increases vision range by 2 tiles when equipped.
Craftable: Yes
Crafting Cost: 12 Wood, 6 Stone

Dagger
Description: A short but sharp dagger that can be obtained from goblins. Slightly increases attack power, critical chance, and critical damage when equipped.
Craftable: No

notes.title: 2025-07-07 Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes
July 7, 2025


1. In-Game Difficulty Adjustments
We have adjusted the difficulty level for each stage as follows:

Stage 1

Starts off easy but gradually becomes more difficult. Portals that spawn monsters will begin to appear. Difficulty: Low → Low-Mid
Monsters: Goblin, Blue Portal, Goblin Warrior



Stage 2
Same types of monsters appear, but stronger versions and greater numbers are introduced.
Difficulty: Low-Mid → Mid
Monsters: Goblin, Goblin Warrior, Blue Portal, Red Portal



Stage 3
Even stronger monsters appear, and the Goblin Shaman makes its first appearance.
Difficulty: Mid → Mid-High
Monsters: Goblin, Goblin Warrior, Goblin Shaman, Red Portal, Purple Portal


2. Critical Hit Interaction System Implemented
Critical hits are now applied during interactions based on your critical hit chance.
A critical interaction deals double the amount of a normal interaction by default.


3. Interaction Automation System Implemented
After acquiring the Interaction Automation upgrade, holding down the left mouse button will repeatedly perform interactions until the button is released.
If you acquire the Automation Speed upgrade, the speed of automated interactions will increase.


4. New Upgrade Nodes Added
The following upgrade options have been added:

Attack Power Increase: Lv. 6–10

Critical Hit Chance Increase: Lv. 1–5

Critical Hit Damage Increase: Lv. 1–3

Recovery Rate Increase: Lv. 1–3

Interaction Automation: Lv. 1

Automation Speed: Lv. 1–5


5. Opportunity Count Adjustment
The number of opportunities given at the start of the game to attempt missions has been increased from 3 to 5.

notes.title: 2025-06-27 Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes
June 27, 2025


1. Game engine changed
Changed from a self-built engine to a Unity engine.


2. Upgrade feature added
You can now upgrade player's abilities on the Upgrade tab on the main view.


3. Simple animations applied
added an animation of monsters and an animation that shakes when interacting with other objects to give it a liveliness.


4. In-game time system added
added time system to divide the day and night, and to create objects differently during the day and night.


5. BGM added
added background music.
